title: Secluded Lakefront Retreat• 30 min to DT Nashville
description:
Experience waterfront bliss in this 3BR, 2BA private lakefront haven! Downstairs, a game room with TV, ping pong, corn hole, and a putting green awaits. Enjoy breathtaking views and your private waterfront! Relax on the screened-in porch,  deck, or by the swing and hammock by the water. Plus, we've added a pickleball court on the old tennis court, perfect for pickleball enthusiasts!

Book your waterfront escape today!

The space
Welcome to Your Waterfront Retreat!

If you're looking for the perfect getaway, you've found it! Our spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers a delightful mix of indoor and outdoor entertainment, all with stunning waterfront views.

Indoor Entertainment:

✤ Game Room: The downstairs game room is your ultimate playground, equipped with a TV for movie nights, a ping pong table for friendly competitions, corn hole for some outdoor fun, and even a small putting green to practice your golf skills.

✤ Living Room: In the main living room, you'll find a TV discreetly tucked away in the cabinet above the fireplace, offering a cozy spot to relax and unwind.

Outdoor Paradise:

✤ Scenic Views: The breathtaking views from the property are to die for, making it a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life. The waterfront is your private haven, a serene backdrop to your stay.

✤ Outdoor Spaces: Enjoy the great outdoors with a screened-in porch where you can sip your morning coffee, a deck for alfresco dining, and a swing and hammock by the water to while away the hours.

✤ Pickleball Court: Sports enthusiasts will be thrilled to find a pickleball court behind the home on the old tennis court. Please note that the tennis court is no longer functional for tennis but perfect for a game of pickleball.

Bedroom Configuration:

✤ Bedroom 1: Relax in the comfort of a King bed.
✤ Bedroom 2: Enjoy a cozy night's sleep in a Queen bed.
✤ Bedroom 3: Perfect for a family, this room features a Full and a Twin bed.

Whether you're here for a family vacation, a friends' reunion, or a relaxing retreat, our waterfront house has it all. Book your stay today and savor the top-notch experiences in store for you!

Please be aware that this is a lakehouse, directly on the water. With that fact comes bugs (outside of the home). We do get the home/property treated, but it's just a part of the beautiful nature that surrounds the home. The property is thoroughly cleaned in between each stay, but there may be some spider webs on the outside of the property, just due to the proximity to the lake. Having said that, we can't wait to host you!!!

Guest access
During your stay, you'll enjoy exclusive access to the entire home, providing you with a private and personalized experience. From the moment you arrive, the space is all yours to explore, relax, and make lasting memories. With no shared spaces or interruptions, you have the freedom to truly unwind and embrace the comfort of having the entire home at your disposal!

Other things to note
✤ The indoor fireplaces are not operable. 
✤ The boat will not be available for guests to use.

There is a rental agreement that needs to be signed after each booking is confirmed. It will be sent over immediately after booking and can be signed digitally.
